designs.name: Twin-Hull Skimmer
designs.summary: Two pontoons with an open water channel between them. Plastic floats in over a submerged ramp into a lift-out mesh basket with a one-way flap. Light, low drag and easy to empty.

steps: Print and check
Print the A4 pack at 100% (Actual size, not Fit to page). The 50 mm bar on every page must measure 50 mm. A print shop can print the large-format file on one sheet instead.
Join the tiles
Trim, then overlap each tile onto the grey strip of its neighbour, matching the 50 mm grid and the letters (A1, A2, B1...). Tape on the back.
Cut the thermocol
Stick each template on 25 mm thermocol with a glue stick. Cut with a hot-wire cutter (cleanest) or a new snap-off blade held upright. Cut red windows and pockets too.
Stack and glue
Push bamboo skewers through the + holes so the three layers line up. Spread Fevicol SH thinly, press, and leave under weight overnight. Do not use Fevikwik or solvent glue.
Shape the bow
The bottom layer is 60 mm shorter and the middle 30 mm shorter, so the bow rises in steps. Sand the steps into a smooth curve with 120-grit paper.
Waterproof
Two coats of PVA with tissue paper (or wrap in brown packing tape), then water-based acrylic paint. Never spray paint: it melts thermocol.
Join the pontoons
Glue the deck on both pontoons with the channel exactly 140 mm wide (use the deck as the gauge). Glue and screw the two wooden crossbars on the marks.
Ramp and basket

Glue the two ramp wedges to the channel walls on the bottom-layer marks, then the mesh ramp on top. Build the basket, tape the PET flap inside the entrance, and hang it by its lips on the pontoon tops.
Fit the motors
Glue the towers and gussets, screw the 2205 motors on the stern side, fit one CW and one CCW 5045 prop so both push air backwards. Glue the guard rings on.
Wire the electronics
Lay the floor guide in the box and fix each part on its outline. ESCs to Pixhawk MAIN 1 (left) and MAIN 3 (right). Pi Zero to TELEM2. ADS1115 on I2C. Seal cable holes with hot glue.
Float test
Put it in a tub with the battery in. The waterline should be close to the figure on the spec card. Slide the battery on its Velcro until the boat sits level.
Set up ArduRover
Skid steering: SERVO1_FUNCTION = 73 (throttle left), SERVO3_FUNCTION = 74 (throttle right). Flash the ESCs to 3D mode so the boat can reverse and turn on the spot.
Set the camera in the app
In Boat Vision settings, enter the camera height and tilt from the spec card.

designs.name: U-Hull Block
designs.summary: One solid piece of stacked thermocol with a 140 mm slot open at the bow. The electronics sit in a pocket cut inside the foam under a hatch, so there is no deck to build. The stiffest, most stable and most forgiving hull for a first build.
